title: approval-record.v1
description: Spec-policy approval record written through the approval port. Binds named authority, decision scope, base manifest, lineage, and spec-policy fingerprint. Missing authority, base, or lineage blocks its scope. Only spec-policy approval changes acceptance identity.

schema_version.description: Schema major version. Canonical schema owns fields; policy owners approve decisions. Unknown versions refuse.

approval_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this approval record.

authority.description: Named authority that issued this approval.

identity.description: Authority identity (no real names, emails, or personal identifiers in repository artifacts).

decision_scope.description: What this approval covers (e.g., spec-policy, criteria, evidence-policy).

base.description: Immutable base manifest or tree retained by the approval record.

manifest_ref.description: Immutable base manifest reference at the time of approval.

lineage.description: Provenance linking this approval to its spec.

predecessor_id.description: Prior approval ID in this lineage, if this supersedes an earlier approval.

spec_policy_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the accepted spec and its evidence policy at the time of this approval.

decision.description: Approval decision. Only the latest valid spec-policy approval governs acceptance; earlier facts remain immutable.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 instant when this approval was written.
